review_candidates.title: Directrice/Directeur de Projets Construction (F/H)
review_candidates.description: Directrice / Directeur de Projets Construction F/H Schiltigheim (67) Au sein du Département Construction de la GBU Local Energy Infrastructures (LEI), vous êtes rattaché au Directeur Construction Nord-Est. Basé dans la mesure du possible au plus près des Maîtres d'Ouvrage internes et des lieux de réalisation des projets, vous assurez la mission de Maîtrise d'Ouvrage Déléguée des projets qui vous sont confiés et pilotez les équipes projets associées. Votre rôle consiste à garantir la bonne réalisation des projets, dans le respect des objectifs de sécurité, de qualité, de performance, de coûts et de délais fixés par le Maître d'Ouvrage. Vos missions : Piloter un portefeuille de projets stratégiques Assurer la maîtrise d'ouvrage déléguée d'un portefeuille de grands projets à CAPEX pour le Département Construction de la GBU LEI. Veiller à l'atteinte des objectifs fixés par le Maître d'Ouvrage en matière de délais, de CAPEX et de performances. Garantir le respect des objectifs de sécurité, de qualité et de performance tout au long des projets. Manager et animer les équipes projets Manager une équipe de Chefs de Projet. Assurer l'animation technique de l'équipe et maintenir l'équilibre entre les ressources disponibles et le plan de charge. Accompagner les équipes dans l'application des standards, méthodes et bonnes pratiques. Coordonner les parties prenantes Piloter et coordonner les différents intervenants internes et externes mobilisés sur les projets. Assurer la diffusion et l'application des standards de la GBU LEI. Déployer la politique sécurité et les démarches d'amélioration Relayer la politique sécurité de la GBU LEI sur votre périmètre. Garantir la mise en œuvre des plans d'actions du Département Construction en matière de technique, d'outils, de méthodes et de réglementation. Contribuer directement à certains projets Intervenir directement en tant que Chef de Projet lorsque les besoins de l'activité le nécessitent. Votre Profil : Formation : BAC+4/5 type : Ingénierie en énergie ou d’un diplôme de niveau équivalent. Expérience : Vous justifiez de plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans le management de projets énergétiques industriels et d'équipes, avec une expérience significative dans la conception-réalisation de réseaux de chaleur et/ou de centrales de production d'énergie. Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez la gestion de projets à fort CAPEX, le pilotage d'équipes pluridisciplinaires ainsi que les enjeux liés à la conception et à la réalisation d'infrastructures énergétiques. Vous êtes en capacité d'assurer le pilotage simultané de nombreux intervenants internes et externes. Savoir-être : Reconnu pour votre capacité à travailler en transverse, vos qualités d'analyse et votre sens du détail, vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'autonomie, de volontarisme et d'un fort sens du service. Votre sens des responsabilités et votre orientation client constituent de véritables atouts pour réussir dans cette fonction. Contrat : CDI Localisation Poste basé à Schiltigheim (67) Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir sur le quart Nord-Est de la France. Ce que nous offrons : Une rémunération attractive : entre 55 000 et 65 000 K€ bruts annuels fixes sur 12,3 mois, complétée d'une part variable selon les résultats. Des missions variées et stimulantes, au cœur des enjeux de la transition énergétique territoriale. Un environnement de travail collaboratif, avec des équipes expertes et engagées. Des perspectives d'évolution réelles au sein d'un groupe international de premier plan. Un cadre professionnel qui valorise l'initiative, l'autonomie et la montée en compétences. Nos engagements Chez ENGIE, chaque talent a un rôle à jouer pour accélérer la transition énergétique. Faites la différence et venez vivre une expérience professionnelle épanouissante, relevez des défis passionnants et construisez le parcours qui vous ressemble. Rejoignez-nous et embarquez pour l'aventure de notre siècle ! Recruteur responsable, ENGIE s’inscrit dans le cadre des Labels Diversité et Égalité obtenus par le Groupe ENGIE et œuvre en faveur d’un recrutement garantissant l’égalité des chances et la non-discrimination. Il agit conformément à la politique Diversité, Équité et Inclusion du Groupe ENGIE, " Be.U@ENGIE ", qui permet à chaque individu d’être respecté et de se sentir libre afin de donner le meilleur de lui-même. Nom de l'entreprise: Local Energy Infrastructures France Salaire de base minimum: 55 000,00 EUR Salaire de base maximum: 65 000,00 EUR Base salariale: Annuelle

review_candidates.title: Director, Site Management-UK
review_candidates.description: Summary As the Director, Site Management UK you will lead Civia Health’s five UK clinical research sites: the Sunderland site and four sites run in partnership with Boots. Alongside portfolio leadership, you will act as the on-site manager for Sunderland. The role brings consistent governance to the Boots sites, builds strong partner relationships, and is the bridge to US site management, so that Civia runs its sites to one standard. Key Responsibilities UK Site Portfolio Leadership Lead the operations and performance of all five UK sites, setting clear priorities and targets for each. Monitor and drive site performance metrics, including recruitment, retention, protocol adherence and visit compliance. Manage site budgets and resources to deliver studies efficiently across the UK portfolio. Sunderland Site Management Act as the on-site manager for Sunderland, overseeing day-to-day operations, staffing and participant experience. Ensure the Sunderland site is always visit-ready and meeting its enrolment and retention goals. Maintain local relations with landlord and key operational partners within Sunderland to facilitate seamless operations within the flagship site. Serve as the primary point of contact for Sunderland in internal and external communications. Boots Sites Governance & Partnership Introduce and run a consistent governance model across the four Boots sites, covering standards, oversight and reporting. Build and maintain strong working relationships with Boots partners at site and leadership level. Resolve partnership issues early and escalate risks that could affect study delivery or client commitments. Study Delivery & Compliance Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of all studies at UK sites, in line with generating valid evidence at scale principles Ensure all UK sites operate in line with ICH GCP, UK clinical trials regulation and Civia SOPs. Be accountable for audit readiness at UK sites, working with the Operational Compliance Specialist, UK, who hosts sponsor audits and coordinates MHRA inspections. Work with sponsors, CROs and internal teams to support feasibility, start-up and study timelines. Use the monthly UK quality dashboard to drive improvement, acting on deviation trends and CAPA with the Operational Compliance Specialist, UK. People Leadership Lead, line manage, coach and develop UK site leaders and site-based staff across all five sites. Lead recruitment, onboarding and retention for UK site teams, and plan succession for key roles. Work with the Site Operational Trainer and Global Training & Compliance so UK site staff are trained, competent and study-ready. Build a high-performance culture of quality, participant safety and continuous improvement. US - UK Site Management Alignment Act as the bridge between UK and US site management, aligning SOPs, metrics and ways of working. Share good practice in both directions and contribute to global site network decisions. Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned, consistent with the scope and level of the position. Required Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven experience leading site or clinic operations in clinical research. Track record of leading people across multiple sites / locations. Strong working knowledge of ICH GCP and UK clinical research regulation, including MHRA and HRA requirements. Demonstrated ability to build strong partner relationships and manage through influence. Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills. Based at or able to commute to Sunderland, and willing to travel between UK sites. Preferred Experience Experience running research sites within a retail, pharmacy or other partner setting. Experience working within a US -UK or global site network. Experience with CRIO, HubSpot or similar CTMS/eSource/CRM platforms. Experience supporting MHRA / FDA / EMA inspections.

review_candidates.title: Director of International Research Partnerships
review_candidates.company: The University of Nottingham Ningbo China
review_candidates.description: University of Nottingham Ningbo China is seeking to recruit a Director of International Research Partnerships in Research and Knowledge Exchange Office. About the role The role will develop and deliver UNNC's external international research partnership and funding agenda. It will build a qualified pipeline of international funding opportunities, strategic university and research-organisation partnerships, major collaborative bids and research-led relationships with international companies. The role is externally facing and outcome driven. It complements the Director of Tri-Campus Research Collaboration, whose primary remit is collaboration within the University of Nottingham's UK, China and Malaysia campuses. The role will work closely with academic leaders and relevant professional services teams to translate strategic partnership opportunities into deliverable research initiatives. Your key responsibilities include: International funding strategy and opportunity pipeline Develop and maintain an evidence-based international research funding strategy aligned with UNNC's priority disciplines and institutional goals. Identify and qualify opportunities from UKRI, Innovate UK, Horizon Europe where eligible, international foundations, multilateral bodies and other relevant sources. Provide targeted funding intelligence and sponsor engagement that leads to defined actions by credible UNNC teams. Strategic international research partnerships Build a selective portfolio of high-value relationships with leading overseas universities, research organisations, funders and innovation bodies. Convert priority relationships into active work plans, named academic connections, joint proposals, research programmes or other measurable outcomes rather than stand-alone memoranda. Represent UNNC in relevant senior international research forums and partnership discussions. International industry research and innovation partnerships Develop research-led relationships with UK and multinational companies that create externally funded collaboration, access to data or facilities, researcher engagement or knowledge-exchange opportunities. Work with Knowledge Exchange, NNTC and faculty teams to route opportunities to the correct commercial, contracting, IP and delivery support. Ensure that prospective partnerships have a clear academic and institutional value proposition. Major international collaborative bids and partnership delivery Lead and coordinate the development of major international collaborative funding bids, from identified opportunities through consortium building, proposal preparation and submission. Mobilise academic leaders and overseas partners around clear research objectives, partner commitments, resources and deliverable outcomes. Work with relevant UNNC teams to progress successful bids and strategic partnerships into funded research activity, with clear responsibilities and implementation arrangements. Take responsibility for ensuring that major international research partnerships undergo appropriate due diligence, risk assessment and institutional approvals, working with relevant University teams and escalating significant issues where necessary. Profile, intelligence and performance management Raise UNNC's international research profile through targeted networks, delegations, funder engagement and evidence-based communication of research strengths. Report regularly against agreed pipeline, bid, partnership and funding KPIs, including attribution and contribution to outcomes. Coordinate with the Director of Tri-Campus Research Collaboration when external opportunities require UNUK or UNM participation. About You You should have exceptional senior relationship-building, influencing and negotiation skills across universities, funders, government and industry. You should have ability to originate opportunities and convert broad relationships into funded, deliverable research activity. You should have strong strategic planning, business development, consortium-building and pipeline-management capability. You should have excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to represent UNNC credibly with senior international stakeholders. You should have substantial senior experience in international research funding, research partnerships or research and innovation policy. You should have strong current knowledge of international funding systems and the requirements of major collaborative programmes. You should have demonstrable record of developing strategic partnerships, funding pipelines, consortia or major bids with measurable outcomes. You should have experience of working successfully with senior academic leaders, researchers, professional services, funders and external organisations. You should have experience of operating within complex governance, risk and compliance environments. You should have a Master's degree and/or relevant professional qualification You should have ability to travel internationally and work flexibly across time zones. You should have commitment to the University's requirements on trusted research, integrity, conflicts, confidentiality and due diligence. About Us Join a unique British University in China. The University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) was the first Sino-foreign university to open its doors in China. Located in Ningbo, this award winning campus offering a UK style education has grown to establish a student body of over 10,000 in more than 22 years. The University of Nottingham Ningbo, China, a pioneer in Sino-foreign tertiary education, is rapidly expanding. It is looking for ambitious, talented academics with a passion for teaching as well as research flair to join its team of science and engineering experts. UNNC is part of the University of Nottinghams Global University, and offers unique teaching and research opportunities in a highly dynamic economy. Your Remuneration, Benefits and Support We are committed to providing competitive employment packages while supporting the wellbeing of our staff to help them reach their full potential. Recruitment to this role is subject to applicable national legislation, including Chinese statutory retirement requirements. Where a candidate has reached or is approaching the applicable statutory retirement age, any retirement deferment or continued engagement beyond the statutory retirement age will be considered separately, in accordance with applicable national regulations and the University's policies and approval requirements. Such arrangements are not automatic and will be subject to regulatory feasibility, institutional need and the circumstances of the individual case. Further information on Chinese statutory retirement age is available here. How to Apply Applicants should submit an application via our on-line application system by 23:59 Beijing time on 19 December 2026 at: https://jobs.nottingham.edu.cn/job/184757/ Only on-line applications made at (http://jobs.nottingham.edu.cn) will be accepted. Referees will be contacted prior to interview and interviews will take place in Ningbo China. Enquiries Informal enquiries may be addressed to Professor Alain Chong, Vice Provost for Research and Knowledge Exchange, email: Alain.Chong@nottingham.edu.cn. If you are unable to apply on-line please contact the Human Resources Office via Email: job@nottingham.edu.cn, with a quote of the reference number of “184757”. Equality and Diversity University of Nottingham Ningbo China is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a fair, equitable and mutually supportive learning and working environment for our students and staff. It is our intention to ensure that job applicants and staff are treated solely on the basis of their merits, abilities and potential, regardless of gender, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, age*, socio-economic background, disability, religious or political beliefs, trade union membership, family circumstances, sexual orientation or other irrelevant distinction. review_candidates.title: Analyst, Growth Generalist
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analyst, Growth Generalist based in Germany. We are looking for a proactive and analytical Growth Generalist to strengthen an international Marketing & Growth team and drive customer acquisition across the Americas and Europe. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of paid media campaigns while contributing to broader growth initiatives across outbound, reporting, automation, and AI-powered workflows. You will manage campaigns across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, optimizing budgets, audiences, creatives, and performance to attract high-quality B2B leads. Beyond paid advertising, you will help build scalable acquisition processes, develop reporting dashboards, and improve lead generation through data and automation. You will work closely with growth, sales, and revenue operations teams in a fast-moving, remote-first environment. This position offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence acquisition strategy, experiment with new tools, and take ownership beyond traditional marketing responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for an adaptable professional who enjoys combining hands-on execution, analytical thinking, and continuous learning. Accountabilities Paid Media Strategy and Management: Own paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, covering strategy, campaign setup, execution, daily optimization, and performance reporting. Audience Targeting: Define and refine target audiences based on the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), ensuring advertising budgets are focused on reaching relevant businesses and decision-makers. Budget Management: Collaborate with growth leadership to allocate and optimize advertising budgets across different channels and geographical markets. Campaign Experimentation: Continuously test audiences, advertising creatives, landing pages, and offers to identify improvement opportunities and translate findings into actionable decisions. Creative Production: Develop static and video advertising assets using AI-powered tools and other creative resources, enabling fast experimentation without relying exclusively on external designers. Outbound Acquisition Support: Research and identify target companies and relevant contacts, enrich prospect data using Clay and similar tools, build lead lists, and support outbound prospecting sequences. Performance Reporting: Build, maintain, and improve dashboards that track acquisition channel performance, lead generation, and campaign effectiveness, translating data into clear business recommendations. Automation and AI Integration: Contribute to the development and optimization of automated workflows and AI agents supporting lead sourcing, qualification, follow-ups, and reporting. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales and revenue operations teams to improve lead quality, streamline handoffs, and ensure accurate attribution of marketing-generated opportunities. Marketing Alignment: Coordinate with communications and brand teams to maintain consistency between brand messaging, campaign creatives, and paid advertising activities. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to expand beyond paid media ownership and improve the overall customer acquisition engine through experimentation, initiative, and practical problem-solving. Requirements Professional Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on paid media experience using at least two of the following platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads. B2B advertising experience is a strong advantage. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to work confidently with data, monitor campaign performance, interpret results, and communicate findings through measurable outcomes. AI Proficiency: Regular practical use of AI-powered tools in daily work, combined with curiosity and enthusiasm for exploring new applications that improve productivity and marketing performance. Adaptability: Ability to learn quickly, adjust to changing priorities, and make informed decisions based on new information. Versatility: Comfortable taking on responsibilities outside your primary area of expertise and contributing to different parts of the acquisition and growth process. English Proficiency: Fluent English is essential, as the role involves collaborating with international teams and working across markets in the Americas and Europe. Ownership and Initiative: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently, taking responsibility for decisions, execution, and results. Communication and Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with marketing, sales, and revenue operations stakeholders. Nice To Have Experience with CRM and prospecting platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Clay. Basic graphic design or video production skills, particularly for creating advertising assets. Previous experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, or startup environments where team members take on diverse responsibilities. Familiarity with the floriculture industry or related B2B supply chain markets. Experience working with international teams and managing campaigns across multiple geographical markets. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Attractive and negotiable salary based on experience, skills, and qualifications. Remote-First Work Environment: Fully remote working arrangements with the flexibility to work from different locations. International Exposure: Collaborate with a diverse, globally distributed team operating across the Americas and Europe. Ownership and Autonomy: Take responsibility for meaningful projects, make independent decisions, and directly contribute to business growth. Professional Development: Opportunities to continuously develop your skills and expand your expertise in growth marketing, paid acquisition, and automation. Learning Support: Financial assistance for technical certifications and other professional learning opportunities. Flexible Work Culture: Work in an independent and versatile environment that encourages initiative, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Career Growth: Opportunity to broaden your responsibilities and develop into a more strategic growth role within a fast-growing international organization. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
